tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rje btsun sa skya pa'i man ngag dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sa ma ya tā rā gu h+ya sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i gsang sgrub/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon ut+pal dmar po dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba dang mu khyud dang bcas pa/ de lta bu zhig bsgom/ de'i lte ba la oṃ gcig rtsibs brgyad la tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swa/ rtsibs mchan la g.yon skor du ā li bcu drug zung gnyis gnyis/ mu khyud la kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi g.yas skor/ yig 'bru thams cad li khri dang 'ol ma se'i phung po ltar dmar ba bsam/ de nas dbang du sdud par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas yul dpon nam/ rang gi yid du 'ong ba gcig pu'am/ mang yang rung ste/ g.yon gyi ut+pa las kho'i mgul bcing*/ g.yas kyi lcags kyus kho'i snying gar btab nas 'gyel bar bsam zhing*/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phar 'phros pas/ bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum/ bu ga dgu/ snying ga'i rnam par shes pa la phog pas/ phyi nang thams cad dmar lam song bar bsam/ de bzhin du 'od zer steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros/ lha klu/ gnod sbyin/ sde brgyad/ rigs drug la phog pas thams cad gong ltar song bar bsgom/ yang 'phros pas snod bcud 'jig rten/ snang srid thams cad kyang dmar lam song bar bsam/ de bzhin du phar 'phros 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dang*/ longs spyod/ 'bru dang bcud/

mi nor thams cad tshur 'dus/ rang gi lus dang khang khyim thams cad gang bar bsgom/ yang rkang zhabs su tshur 'dus/ de la dmigs pa rgyun mi chad yang yang dmigs la/ rlung 'byung 'jug mi dmigs pas sngags 'di bzla'o// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo wa shaṃ ma na ya

dpe la lar hrīḥzhes pa 'byung*/ nṛ dzaḥ wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ 'khor lo snga ma ltar bris la dpung pa g.yon pa'am mgul du gdags/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i nang du gang dbang du bsdu 'dod pa de'i liṅga rang gi mdun du bzhag nas dmigs pas yang yang bstim/ bsgrub bya'i gos rkang rjes kyis/ rdza sa'am/ sa bzang ba gzhan dag rnams mchod rten de'i nang du bcug la/ rdog zhabs su mnan cing*/ dmigs pa gong ltar bya/ rgyal po/ blon po/ mi bsod nams can la byed dus lce dpral bar/ lcags dang zer ba'ang gda'/ steng 'khor lo 'khor bar bsgom/ rang gi zhabs su bsam/ bud med dbang du byed pa la gsang gnas nas lcags kyus bzung nas rtsa brgyud mar song*/ dmar lam gyur nas drag tu 'gugs shing liṅgar bstim/ dbang du sdud na/ 'od zer tshur la sdud/ bzlas pa mi byed pa'i dus su bcud kyi sems can thams cad jo mo'i skur bsgom/ snang ba thams cad dmar po la sems gtad/ thun mtshams su rin po che'i snod du/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ gtor sngags la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags la 'bul lo// dbang gi 'khor lo rang gis btags/ zla ba phyed dam zhag bcu tshun la mngon sum du 'grub nges so// gzhung nas tshes gcig nas bcu tshun la 'grub par gsungs shing*/ man ngag rnal 'byor rgyud las gsungs so// slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdams pa'o// ༈ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ tā ra rak+ta ga ti wa shaṃ bidhi tsakra nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por re zhig rnal 'byor pas/ ga pur dang*/ gur gum dang*/ gla rtsi dang*/ tsan+dan rnams kyis gro ga la ut+pal 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa bris la/

'dab ma re re la'ang sngags 'di dag tshes brgyad la bri bar bya'o// oṃ tā re tut+tā re san+tā rā hrīḥswā hā/ zhes lte ba dang bcas par ro// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru pa ta dha tā ra ṇi hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa ni mu khyud la'o// steng 'og gi bdag nyid kyi 'dab ma dang bcas par gsum rim mo// de nyid rab tu gnas par byas la dril ba srad bu dmar pos dkris shing*/ sa'i mchod rten khru gang pa'i nang du gzhug par bya'o// gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor ma reg pa'i maṇ+ḍal la sin+dhū ra'am mtshal la sogs pas sbags par bya'o// der mchod rten bzhag par bya'o// me tog a shwa ka la sogs pa'i me tog lcags kyu can gyis sam med na me tog dmar po gang rung gis dus gsum du yang dag par mchod nas/ sngon du gsungs pa'i sngags dang*/ bsgrub bya'i ming spel dang bcas pa brgyad lhag pa'i brgya rab tu bzla'o// de ltar nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du sgrub pa byas na/ 'khor los sgyur ba yang nges par dbang du 'gyur na gzhan lta ci smos/ gal te grub par ma gyur na seng ldeng dmar po'i me la 'khor lo bdug na the tshom med par 'grub par 'gyur ro// sgrol ma dmar mo'i 'gro ba dbang du bya ba'i cho ga'o// de'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa/ tshogs gnyis kyi sbyor ba sngon du gtang bar bya'o// de nas pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba dmar po'i steng du ut+pal dmar po'i ge sar la hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bskyed pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ gcig shos kyis ut+pa las mtshan pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ dpa' mo'i cha byad dang ldan pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung du gnas pa/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i cod pan can du bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re san+ta tā rā hrīḥche ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru zhes kha dog dmar por bcas pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu dang*/

zhags pa lta bu rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pas bsgrub bya gang dbang du bya ba'i snying ga la sogs par lcags kyus bzung ste/ ut+pala'i zhags pas mgul pa nas bcings shing bkug pa de nyid 'od du zhu nas rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam/ sngags bzla bar bya'o// bzlas pa'i man ngag go /sgrol ma dmar mo'i 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa rdo rje gdan pa bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /ngag dbang grags pa las brgyud pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo'i dbang sdud sa skya pa'i man ngag bzhugs so// na maḥtā rā bhaṭ+ṭā ra kā ya na mo na maḥ bdag nyid brdzus skyes su rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ sku mdog dmar mo rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ g.yas na lcags kyu/ g.yon na me tog ut+pal dmar po 'od zer can bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba zhig bsgoms la/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bsgom/ de'i lte bar oṃ hā/ rtsibs brgyad la tā re tut+tā re swa zhes pa bsam/ rtsibs mchan brgyad la/ ā li dmar po bcu drug zung re re bsam/ phyi'i mu khyud la kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi g.yas skor du bsam/ yig 'bru rnams mtshal dkar ram/ 'ol ma se ltar dmar hram me ba'o// de nas rgyal po'am/ yul dpon nam/ gang dbang du bsdu 'dod pa de dag phyag g.yas kyi lcags kyus snying dkar nag mtshams nas bzung*/ g.yon gyi ut+pa las ske nas bcings shing bkug ste/ bdag gi mdun du gan rkyal du 'gyel bar bsam zhing*/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od nyi zer lcags kyu lta bu phar 'phros pas/ bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum/ bu ga dgu/ snying ga'i rnam par shes pa la phog pas/

phyi nang thams cad dmar lam lam song bar bsgom/ de bzhin du 'od zer steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros/ lha klu gnod sbyin sde brgyad/ rigs drug la phog pas thams cad gong ltar song bar bsgom/ yang 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud 'jig rten snang srid thams cad dmar lam gyis song bar bsgom/ de las kyang phar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad la phog pas de thams cad kyang dmar lam song bar bsam/ de bzhin du phar 'phros/ yang rkang zhabs su tshur bsdu/ de la dmigs pa rgyun mi chad par yang yang dmigs la/ sngags 'di bzlas so// oṃ tā re tut+tā re che ge mo wa shaṃ ma na ya nṛ dzaḥpa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ dzaḥswāhā/ 'khor lo bsgom pa ltar bris la/ dpung pa g.yon pa'am/ mgul du gdags/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i nang du gang dbang du bsdu 'dod pa de bris la/ rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ dmigs bya yang yang bstim/ bsgrub bya'i gos/ rkang rjes kyi sa/ rdza sa'am/ sa bzang ba gzhan dag gam/ sder nang du bcug la rdog zhabs su mnan cing dmigs pa gong ltar bya/ rgyal po/ blon po/ mi bsod nams can la byed dus/ lce steng 'khor lo 'khor bar bsgom/ rang gi zhabs su bsam/ bud med dbang du byed pa la/ gsang gnas su lcags kyus bzung nas rtsa brgyud mar song dmar lam gyur nas drag tu 'gugs shing*/ liṅga la bstim/ dbang du byed mi 'dod na/ 'od zer tshur mi bsdu/ bzlas pa mi byed pa'i dus su'ang bcud kyis sems can thams cad jo mo'i skur bsgom/ snang ba thams cad dmar po la sems gtad/ thun mtshams su rin po che'i snod du/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ gtor sngags la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags la 'bul lo// dbang gi 'khor lo rang la btags pa ma 'dzom yang nyan gsungs/ zla ba phyed nas zhag bcu tshun chod la mngon sum du 'grub nges so// the tshom med do// gzhung nas tshes gcig nas bcu tshun chad du 'grub par gsungs so// sngags 'di rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las gsungs so// slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdams pa'o// sa māp+ta mi thi/

bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'o// shin tu zab pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// yar klungs pa siṃ ha dh+wa dza bha dras dag par sug bris bgyis pa maṅgalaṃ/ bla ma'i man ngag ma bral zhing*// dam tshig ldan pa'i skye bo yis// bsgrubs na 'grub par the tshom med// snod min rnams la gsang bar bya// // //bka' rgya dam po bdog lags so// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re a mu kaṃ wa shaṃ ma na ya nṛ wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ dzaḥswāhā/ sngags kyi dag yig go/ ༈ /na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nān/ zhes pa nas sañcar swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo wa shaṃ ma nā ya swāhā/ zhes pa la gtor sngags sbyar/ gtor ma med na yang*/ lag pa thal mo sbyar/ rkang pa skyil krung bcas la mdun du dmigs nas/ gong ltar sngags kyis dbul bar bya'o// gtor ma med kyang sgom pa dang sngags la 'bad pas chog gsung ngo*// ༈ /sa skya pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo'i lung len pa'i thog mar slob dpon lhar bskyed/ mdun du lha bskyed la mchod bstod gtor ma phul la/ maṇ+ḍal phul sems bskyed la gsol ba gdab/ slob ma lhar bskyed cing bzlas lung sbyin/ bcom ldan bdag la/ 'di la sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/ rjes kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba rnams bya'o// sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'i phyag len ma nor ba yin no// ༈ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i dbang gi sbyin sreg gi man ngag bzhugs so// na mo bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka tā rā yai/ dbang gi sbyin sreg gi man ngag ni/ stegs bu dmar por thab khung zla gam dmar po ngos shar bstan/ rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed/ mchu dang kha khyer la sor bzhi bzhi yod pa/ kha khyer la lcags kyus mtshan pa/ nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar lcags kyu can bri brtsig brko ba gang rung bya/ der bud shing ni/ lci ba la ni gtan byar mi rung*/ tsam pa ka sogs bod du mi rnyed pas seng ldeng ngam/

kham bu'am/ shug pa'am/ mdzo mo shing sogs shing dmar pos brtsig thab kyi g.yas su ba lu sogs zhi rdzas ma yin pa'i shing kha dog dmar po/ 'bras bu can gyi yam shing sor lnga pa sbyin sreg gang byed kyi grangs dang mthun pa/ dri bzang dmar po dang mngar gsum gyis sbags pa dang*/ tsha ba'i til mar ram mar khu la 'bri mog bsres pa dang*/ tsher ma lcags kyu can kyi shing dang me tog dmar po lcags kyu can rnyed tshad dang*/ 'bras chen zho dang mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i zas mchog dang*/ dar zab dmar po'i na bza' dang*/ bsgrub bya'i liṅga sngags can dgug gzhug byas pa rnams bsham/ yang lhag pa'i lha dang me lha'i gtor ma gnyis bsham/ g.yon du zangs snod du dri dang me tog dmar po blugs pas mchod yon dang*/ me tog dmar po dri zhim po dang*/ a ga ru'i spos dang*/ 'bri mog bsres pa'i mar me dang*/ tsan+dan dmar po dang gur gum sbyar ba'i dri chab dang*/ mngar gsum las sbrus pa'i bshos dmar po ste mchod pa tshar gsum bsham/ bris thab yin na mdun du me sgrib cig bzhag de'i nang du rdo rje dril bu/ bsang chu/ ku sha dgang blugs dang*/ rlung g.yab bzhag de nas srod chen po'i dus su/ bdag nyid khrus byas/ dri bzang dmar po dang sin+dhū ras lus la byug chas gos rgyan thams cad dmar po bya/ stan dmar po la kha nub tu bstan nas sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 'dug la/ chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pas/ lha'i rnal 'byor shin tu brtan par bsgom/ smra ba bcad/ rdor dril bzung*/ ku sha'i rtse mos bsang chu blangs te/ g.yon nas brtsams nas g.yas skor du/ thab dang*/ bsreg rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dgang blugs thams cad bsang*/ rgyal po'am/ smad 'tshong ma'i nang nas byung ba'i me snod du bzhag pa sbar nas bsangs la/ bud shing dang lhan du me tshang du bcug oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ ku shas thab la g.yogs la bzhag de nas me bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las ye shes kyi thab khung zla gam dmar po mchu kha khyer dang bcas pa'i nang*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du ram̐ las me lha dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa ag tshom can du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa bkug la/ thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng du ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs pa la/ bsang chus phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ mchod yon dbul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing*/ mchod pa sna lnga rol mo dang bcas pa dbul/ pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis g.yas par blugs gzar dang*/ g.yon pas dgang gzar bzung*/ lag gnyis pus mo'i nang las phyir mi 'da' bar byas la/ dgang blugs kyi kha la ram̐ dang me lha'i ljags la ram̐ bkod de dgang blugs g.yas su bskor bas me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul la me'i ltas brtag de nas yam shing dang*/ sreg blugs dang*/ me tog dmar po dang*/ zas mchog rnams bdun bdun dbul/ de'i tshe sngags ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pa 'ba' zhig gis dbul/ yam shing dang me tog ni g.yas pa'i mchog sbyin gyis phyag rgyas mtheb srin gyis dbul/ gzhan rnams ni blugs gzar gyis dbul/ blugs gzar rkyang pas 'bul ba ni sreg blugs yin la/ dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba'i steng du blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba sbrags nas 'bul ba ni dgang blugs so// yam shing ni me'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ me tog ni phyag tu dang*/ gzhan rnams ni zhal du 'bul lo// de nas bsang chus bsangs pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su/ sgrol ma sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ bstim/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod byas la/ sgrol ma'i zhal la hrīḥdang dgang blugs kyi kha la hrīḥbakod la dgang blugs bdun 'bul/

de nas yam shing dang*/ sreg blugs dang*/ me tog dmar po dang*/ zas mchog rnams rim par dbul/ sngags ni las sngags 'ba' zhig gis dbul/ yam shing dang*/ sreg blugs dang me tog 'bul thengs re dang sngags re sbyar ba la sbyin sreg ces bya ba yin pas grangs bzung ste brgya stong gi bar dbul lo// de nas liṅga rnams dbul zhing sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i las sbyor gyi dmigs pa de dag gsal bar nan tan gyis bsgom/ de nas na bza' dbul/ gtor ma'ang dgang blugs kyis dbul/ mchod bstod 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod gsol dang gshegs gsol bya/ de nas me 'bar ba me lhar gyur pa la/ na bza' dang*/ gtor ma 'bul/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams ma lus par dbul/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol bya/ dge ba bsngo/ long skabs yod na me ma shi bar du mi dkrugs/ mi bdal/ mi 'gom/ long med na 'o ma dmar pos me gzhil la thal ba bsgrub byas 'thung ba'i chu la dor ro// ho ma bi dhi u pa de sha sa māp+ta// ༈ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i man ngag bzhugs so// 'gro rnams dbang sdud dang thar pa'i lam la 'god// rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi// man ngag lag len bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri// de yang gnas dben par nyi ma ma phog pa'i sas maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa rgyar mda' gang pa/ dpangs su mkhyud gang ba byas la sin+dhū ra'am mtshal gyis dmar por byugs pa'i dbus su zla gam gyi gzugs bris pa'i phyi rol ut+pal dang lcags kyus bskor ba dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris par gang dbang du bya ba'i bsgrub

1 bya de'i gzugs bris pa'i snying gar hrīḥ rgyab tu oṃ tā re tut+tā re san+tā rā hrīḥche ge mo'i mi nor zas gsum wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pa sin+dhū ra'am tshon gyis bris la/ srad bu dmar pos rgya gram du bcings nas/ snying gar gzungs thag dmar po btags la pad+ma'i lte bar rang la mdun phyogs par gan rkyal du dpe la lar/ tā re ṇe zhes pa'ang snang*/ bzhag go /de'i steng du skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par blangs pa'i sa bzang po la/ mchod rten 2 dmar po khru gang pa nang stong par byas la/ tsan+dan nam shug pa dmar po'i srog shing gdugs dang chos 'khor dang bcas pa btsugs la/ mchod rten bum pa'i shar gyi thad du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bri zhing sgrol ma'i sngags dang ye dharmā shog bu la bris la srog shing la dkris nas srog shing de nyid phyung 'jug nyan par byas la/ mchod rten gyi bum par me tog dmar po blugs la/ ye dharmā dang bkra shis brjod la rab gnas bya'o// tshes brgyad kyi nyin par gro ga la/ gur gum/ gla rtsi/ tsan+dan/ sin+dhū ra rnams kyis 'khor lo u 3 t+pal pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bris pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re san+tā rā hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa bri/ mu khyud la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru saṃ tā ra tā ra ṇi hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa bris te/ 'khor lo de lta bu kha sbyar la/ ye dharmās rab gnas byas la dril te srad bu dmar pos rgya gram du bcings nas mchod rten gyi bum pa'i srog shing la gdags so// me tog lcags kyu can gyi rigs rnyed tshad dang*/ gzhan yang me tog dmar po gang rnyed dang*/ bzang drug dang*/ sin+dhū ra rnams sngags chus sbrus la ril 4 bu byas/ dar dmar pos dril nas 'khor lo dang lhan cig tu bcings la gzungs thag srog shing gi brgyud la drang*/ mthar mchod pas bskor/

dkar gtor gcig bsham/ me tog dmar po'i mchod pa'ang 'du bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song bas/ tshad med pa bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po dang*/ a las ri bong can dmar po'i steng du/ ut+pal dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas lcags kyu dang g.yon ut+pa las mtshan pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung du gnas pa'am/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying ga'i nang du hrīḥdamar po bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la mchod nas/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pas bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas/ rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ gis gsol ba gdab/ rigs lngas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi te ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas rang gi thugs kar ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar zla ba dmar po/ de'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po'i mthar sngags kyi yi ge'i phreng ba dmar pos bskor ba dmigs la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re san+tā rā hrīḥswāhā/ zhes ci rigs par bzla'o// de nas mdun gyi mchod rten de/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/

stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs dang bcas pa'i nang gi 'khor lo de nyid bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom/ mchod rten 'og gi liṅga gang dbang du bya ba'i bsgrub byar dmigs la/ bdag la snying nye ba dung dung byed par bsam/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas/ sgrol ma dmar mo dpag tu med pa 'phros nas bsgrub bya gang yin pa rang dbang med par lcags kyus bla ma'i lce rtse/ mi chen gyi snying ga bud med kyi gsang gnas nas bzung*/ ut+pa la'i zhags pas mgul pa nas bcings te bkug pas rang dang mdun bskyed kyi rkang pa'i 'og tu gnas par bsam zhing*/ snga dro'i thun la bdag bskyed ltar bzla zhing*/ phyi dro'i thun la rtsa sngags kyi dod du/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re san+ta rā tā ra ṇi che ge mo dbang du sdus shig rat+na sid+dhi wa shaṃ ku ru hrīḥswāhā/ zhes bzlas la/ snang ba thams cad dmar po'i rang bzhin du song bar bsam mo// thun gyi mtshams rnams su gtor ma bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun du sgrol ma bskyed la ye shes pa bstims nas dbang bskur zhing rgyas btab bdag bskyed ltar bya/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ bsnyen sngags la a kā ro btags pa gsum la sogs pas phul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// grub na sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir dbang gi sbyin sreg bya/ de lta bu'i sgrub pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrubs pas nges par 'grub bo// sgrub pa thon pa na/ 'khor lo dar dmar pos dril la rang gi mchan khung g.yon du bcang bar bya'o// ril bus dbang du bya ba ni lus sam gos la reg pas dbang du 'du'o// gal te sgrub pa 'gyangs na zangs sder gyi nang du/ seng ldeng dmar po zla gam du brtsigs pa'i me la 'khor lo bdug cing rang nyid sgrol mar bskyed la snga ma ltar sngags bzlas pas nges par 'grub cing*/

phyis nas dmigs pa tsam gyis kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro gsung ngo*// thun mtshams la sogs par mchod bstod bya zhing*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba la sogs pa byas nas mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab cing sgrub pa thon pa dang*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// sgrol ma dmar mo'i 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i man ngag sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zhal shes rnams bla ma sras pas bskul ba'i ngor/ a wa dhū ti pa'i btsun pa bsod nams kyis yi ger bkod pa 'dis 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs par gyur cig maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥsaṅgu ru pā dā ya/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba mang po la phan gdags pa'i phyir khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo bsgom par 'dod pas/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas/ 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par bsams la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po dang a las zla ba dmar po'i steng du ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig ut+pal dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon pas ut+pal dmar pos mtshan pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan zhing rab tu dpa' mo'i cha lugs can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol zhing 'od zer dmar po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i stod du zla ba dmar po'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar pos brgyan pa/ zhes dam tshig pa bskyed nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ gong ltar mchod nas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gam/ bsdu na/ lha dang lha min sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra lan gcig sbyar ba'i me tog sogs kyis mchod/ de rnams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu mām̐/ zhes gsol ba btab pas 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam zhing*/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de yun ring du bsgom par bya'o// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/

thugs ka'i ut+pal hrīḥdang bcas pa gsal btab nas/ hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par dbang du byas/ de dang lhan cig khams gsum gyi skye 'gro kun gyi dpal 'byor thams cad kyang bsdus nas rang dbang du byas par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re san+tā rā hrīḥswāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla bar bya'o// thun las ldangs pa'i tshe bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar phyung la gong ltar mchod bstod byas nas/ 'dod don zhus te gshegs su gsol zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngos la/ gnas skabs thams cad du rje btsun ma dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya/ 'di'i las tshogs rnams yi ge rnying pa na gsal ba ltar bya'o// zhes sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs shin tu gsal ba 'di ni e waṃ chos 'khor rtser dpal ldan don grub kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /rjes gnang byed na ji ltar rigs pa'i stegs bu ras sam dar dmar pos bkab pa'i steng du maṇ+ḍal tsan+dan dmar pos byugs pa la/ 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu dmar po gcig byas pa mañji sogs kyi steng du bzhag de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod gru bzhi dang*/ mdun du gtor ma dmar po gcig bshams la/ mchod pa rnams a mṛs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang*/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gong bzhin bya/ de nas mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sngar bzhin yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa la mchod pa byin brlabs te/

mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro bas phul la bstod pa bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ gong gi sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul la/ mchod bstod byas te/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ de nas khrus byas pa'i slob ma la sems bskyed gsal btab nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad sogs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum bya/ de nas slob ma lhar bskyed cing ye shes dbab pa spyi ltar byas pa la bzlas lung sbyin/ slob mas me tog dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dang*/ me tog gtor te byin gyis brlab/ 'di la thugs kyi rjes gnang med pas/ gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun par byas la slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags re rer sbyar ba'i mchod bstod dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod gsol byas la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol dang*/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod cing bkra shis sogs bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang dge bshes rin chen 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rdo rje gdan pa bsod snyoms pa'i rgya gzhung dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge las ngag 'don bde bar dpal ldan don grub kyis e wam̐ chos 'khor rtser bris pa'o// maṅgalaṃ//

༈ /bstod pa ni/ snying rjes zhi mtha' khegs pa'i 'od zer dmar po 'bum dkrigs pas// sa gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu'i brtan pa rang dbang med 'phrog cing*// srid zhi'i yon tan sgo brgya 'byed kyang mtshan rtog las grol dbyings// rgyal kun skyed dang rol pa'i yum gcig sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal// zhes pa 'di'ang dgos skabs zhig tu wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhas spel ba'o// ༈ /rje btsun ma sgrol ma dmar mo'i bsnyen sgrub las kyi man ngag bung ba myos pa'i 'gram chang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mas+saṅgu ru rak+ta tā rā yai/ mdzes sdug rnam par sgeg pa'i skyed tshal las// ut+pal gsar pa'i 'gugs byed rab g.yo bas// skye 'gro'i bung ba dbang du sdud mdzad pa'i// rje btsun dpyid kyi dpal mos skyongs gyur cig /'di la blo dang myong ba yi// ge sar yangs pa'i skabs dman kyang*// rtsom 'dod bung ba bzhad pa las// man ngag sbrang rtsi 'di skyugs so// de'ang slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa'i rgya gzhung la brten pa'i rjes btsun sgrol ma dmar mo'i las khrigs kyi man ngag nyams su len pa la nyer bsdogs dang*/ dngos dang rjes su 'gro ba sdom pa las/ dang po la bzhi/ mchod rten dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ stegs bu dang*/ liṅga bca' ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyal gyi nyin bkra shis pa'i sa dang*/ gnas khyad par can gyi sa dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i gdung dang*/ sngags chu sbyar ba'i 'jim pa sa sel dang ma 'dres pa las/ mchod rten pad spungs kyi rnam pa/ bre man chad khog stong du bzos la/ mtshal dang pra rtsis byug bum pa'i mdun la yi ge gsum bri/ tsan+dan dmar po'am ma 'byor na shug pa dmar po'i srog shing gi rtse la gdugs bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ rtsa ba 'phang mdung gi rtse lta bu/ mdun ngos la 'khor lo gzhug pa'i khung bu yod pa/ sgrol ma'i sngags dang*/ rten 'brel snying pos khyab par bris pa de lta bu nang du bcug pa'i mchod rten khru gang pa shin tu mdzes par 'ong ba zhig byas la/

de nyid sgrol mar bskyed bstim mchod cing bstod/ me tog dmar po 'thor zhing ye dharmā dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis brjod pas rab gnas bya'o// gnyis pa 'khor lo ni/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gzhung ltar na/ tshes brgyad dang skar ma rgyal gyi nyin/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma bsngos la/ 'dod gsol gdab/ gos dmar po gyon la kha nub tu phyogs pas chags pa'i sems kyis/ gzhi dmar po'i steng du dar dmar po'am shog bu la mtshal byugs pa gru bzhi pa gnyis la bu mo lo bcu gnyis ma'i rang byung gi khrag dang*/ khye'u lo bcu drug pa'i srin lag g.yon pa'i khrag dang*/ ga bur dang*/ gur gum dang*/ tsan+dan dmar po dang*/ gla rtsi dang*/ rgya skyegs dang*/ sin+dhū ra sbyar ba'i snag tsha byas la/ tsan+dan dmar po'i smyu gus ut+pa la 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa mu khyud me ri dang bcas pa bri/ lte ba'i dbus su oṃ gnyis mgo sprad/ 'dab ma so so la yig mgo phyir bstan pa'i/ tā re tut+tā re san+tā rā hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa tshar gnyis kyi yig 'bru re re bri/ phyi'i mu khyud la oṃ tā re tut+tā re san+tā rā hrīḥyul che ge mo'i gnas che ge mo na gnas pa'i rigs rus che ge mo can gyi ming che ge mo bla dgas dang bcas pa wā sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥhrīḥswāhā/ zhes nyis rim dang har stong med pa khrig 'grigs pa bri/ de ni 'og 'khor ro// stod 'khor yang de lta bu las kha 'og tu phyogs pa can bri'o// ngag dbang grags pa'i rgya gzhung ltar na/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar oṃ dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas rim bzhin/ tā re/ tut+tā re/ tu re/ swāhā rnams dang*/ rtsibs mchan brgyad la ā li bcu drug gi yig 'bru gnyis re dang*/ mu khyud la kā li sum cu so bzhi ste/ thams cad kyang yig mgo phyir bstan g.yas skor du bri/

de gnyis gang ltar yang zangs gzhong du me tog dmar po'i steng du 'khor lo bzhag la/ bdag bskyed kyi nga rgyal brtan pos sbyong khrus sngon du btang*/ 'khor lo sgrol mar bskyed/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod/ sgrol ma 'od du zhu nas yig 'bru dang ut+pa la'i rnam par dmar hrom mer song bar bsgom pa dang*/ 'khor lo snga ma ltar na yang 'od kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pas bsgrub bya rang dbang med par bkug de 'od du zhu ba ming yig la bstim pa'i dmigs pa lan mang du bya/ gnyis po gang ltar yang rten 'brel snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags mang du bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor bas lhag par gnas par byas la/ 'khor lo ma 'chol bar kha sbyar la dril/ skud dmar gyis rgya gram du bar mtshams med par dkris pa dang*/ glang po sna sogs me tog dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dang*/ 'khor lo'i bri rdzas bsres pa sngags chus sbrus pa'i ril bu mang du byas pa dar dmar gyi thum bur gtum pa dang bcas pa srog shing gi ngos kyi khung bur gzhug pa'am ma shong na srog shing la gdags pas kyang 'thus so// gsum pa stegs bu ni/ nyi ma ma phog pa'i sa la gru bzhi mda' gang*/ dpangs su mkhyud gang pa byas la/ sin+dhū ra dang mtshal gyis byugs pa'i steng du/ maṇ+ḍal zla gam khru gang pa ngos shar du bstan pa/ de'i phyir sor bzhi'i nyis rim can/ phyi rol du ut+pa la'i zhags pa dang lcags kyu spel bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su mchod rten gyi rgya dang mnyam pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lte bar mgo nub tu bstan pa'i lcags kyus mtshan pa bri'o// bzhi pa liṅga ni/ shog bu la sin+dhū ra dang rgya skyegs dang*/ mtshal gyis bsgrub bya'i gzugs gcer bu gan rkyal bzhag pa/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings pa/ snying gar nṛ/ dpral bar rus/ lto bar ming yig rgyas pa wā sh+yaṃ ku ru hā+oḥ

'doms su bla dwags rgyab kyi snying ga'i thad du hrīḥ de'i mthar 'khor lo'i mu khyud kyi sngags bri/ skud dmar gyis rgya gram du bcings la/ snying ga'i nṛ la gzungs thag dmar po'i sne mo spyin gyis sbyar/ de maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su rang la mgo bstan te bzhag de'i snying gar mchod rten gyi srog shing reg par byas la gzungs thag srog shing la brgyud pa rang gi bzung chog pa bya zhing*/ mchod rten gyi nang go mtshams med par mchod pa'i me tog lcags kyu can dmar pos bkang la bzhag de'i mthar zho dang*/ mngar gsum dang*/ 'bras zan sgrub pa'i gtor ma dmar po sha dang sgog pa sbangs pa dang*/ mchod pa sna lnga dmar pos bskor ro// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed dang*/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa po 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ gdams pa'i lung nos pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pas mtshams dam par bcad/ gos dmar po gyon/ kha nub tu phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ khyad par du bsgrub bya de nyid la phan gdags pa'i phyir dbang du bsdus nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag tu byas te/ rang 'dod kyi lhad ma zhugs pa gal che gsungs/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags yid kyis bzlas shing a haṃ gi don zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid stong pa nyid bsgom/ de'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur drwa ba bla bre me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar po'i steng du rang gi sems nyid nā da las hrīḥdamar po'i rnam pa/ de las ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ltar gsal ba nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rnam par sgeg cing rjes su chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/

phyag g.yas pas ut+pa la dmar po'i 'dab ma'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon pas ut+pa la dmar po'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum zur gyis gzigs shing zhal gyi 'dzum pas 'jig rten gyi gtso bo mtha' dag gi yid 'phrog pa/ dbu skra phyed gyen du bcings shing phyed thur du grol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ mngon par rgyas pa'i nu ma zung gis brang gi dkyil 'khor mdzes pa/ gsang ba'i chu skyes rnam par g.yo ba'i kun dga' can/ sku las shin tu dmar zhing gsal la rno ba lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyi tshogs phyogs kun tu 'phros pas/ sa gsum po thams cad 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin du yongs su gsal zhing zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa/ de'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ gi nang du hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas brtan g.yo 'khor 'das thams cad la rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i sku nam mkha' gang ba spyan drang*/ mchod cing phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang dang dbyer med du bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa la mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis yas babs kyi tshul du dbang bskur dri ma dag mas brtan gyi tshul du chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rang gi bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ zhes yan lag bzhis bskyed/ tshig sna bsdu na rjes gnang gi yig cha bzhin byed chog cing mdun bskyed la'ang 'gre/ de nas rang gi thugs kar ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar zla ba dmar po'i steng du hrīḥyig gi tha mar sngags kyi yi ge mar me'i phreng ba lta bu rab tu dmar bas bskor ba de las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ skye 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus te me tog la bung ba 'du ba ltar rang la 'dud cing lha 'dre mi gsum gyi rnam par shes pa a tri nṛ yig gi rnam par yod pa rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par bsams la/

oṃ tā re tut+tā re san+tā rā hrīḥswāhā/ zhes rtsa ba'i sngags 'di nyid bzlas pa'i skyon drug dang bral bas zlos pa ni bsnyen pa'am sgrub pa'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ mdun gyi mchod rten de/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas par bskyed pa'i nang du 'khor lo de nyid bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin du rje btsun mar dmigs/ de'i thugs kar yang bris pa ji lta ba'i 'khor lo de nyid gsal btab la gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa dgug bstim/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal pad+ma rā ga'i dong zla gam gyi rnam par can gyi nang du zla ba dmar po'i steng du liṅga de nṛ las bsgrub bya dngos su gsal la/ de nas bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas sgrol ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa can mtha' yas pa bsgrub bya gang na gnas pa'i phyogs su spros/ de rnams kyis ut+pa la'i zhags pas bsgrub bya'i ske nas bcings/ lcags kyus pho'i snying ga dang mo'i skye gnas nas drangs/ las kyi rlung dmar gyis bteg 'dar hri li li rang dbang med par bkug nas liṅga dang dbyer med du yang yang bstim/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i zhabs 'og tu mnan par bsams la bsgrub bya'i gos dang*/ rkang rjes kyi sa yod na mchod rten dang*/ rang gi rdog zhabs su mnan par gsungs kyang stegs bu'i rgyu la bsres na'ang rung*/ rang gi thugs ka nas lha mo dmar mo bum pa thogs pa mang po spros pas bsgrub bya la dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi dmar pos bkrus pas rang la ma dad pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ lus dmar por bsgyur/ rang la snying nye dung dung*/ shes pa phyo phyo 'dug pa las/ lus kyi bcud thams cad 'od dmar po'i rnam par snying gar 'dus/ snying ga'i dwangs ma lnga por rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥ'i ra btags la thim pas rang gi lus 'od dmar pos dmar ltem gyis gang bar bsam zhing*/

yang bsgrub bya'i dwangs ma lnga po mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo la yang thim pas/ bsgrub bya lus shin tu rid pa sems med pa khang stong ltar 'dug par bsams la/ tsan+dan dmar po'i bgrang phreng ming med la bkal ba 'dren zhing gzungs thag bzung ste rtsa ba'i sngags kyi tā re ṇi dang hrīḥ'i bar du che ge mo wā sh+yaṃ ku ru bcug pas las sngags su gyur pa 'di bzla'o// 'di ni sgrub pa chen po'am las sbyor ro// bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pas nam phyed nas nyin phyed tshun bdag bskyed dang rtsa sngags bzlas pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ nyin phyed nas nam phyed kyi bar du mdun bskyed dang bcas pas las sngags bzlas pa'i las sbyor mdzad pa 'di lugs gcig yin/ yang thog ma nyid nas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dril sgrub du byas te las sngags 'ba' zhig zlos pa ni lugs gcig ste phyi ma legs par bzhed do// de dag ni rdo rje gdan pa'i gzhung gi man ngag gtsor smos pa yin la/ ngag dbang grags pa ltar na bdag bskyed kyi thugs kar yang pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo bri bya bzhin bsgom pa dang*/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i bzla bya/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo wa shaṃ ma na ya nṛ dza wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ dzaḥswāhā/ zhes pa ni khyad par ro// gsum pa thun mtshams su bya ba ni/ tho rangs/ snga dro/ phyi dro/ srod de thun bzhir sgom bzlas chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bya zhing*/ zer gnyis dang gung gnyis su thun mtshams kyi spyod lam bya ste rtsa ba'i sngags kyi sham bur ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs btags nas mchod pa dbul zhing*/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod/ gtor ma ni/ yi ge gsum dang a kā ro dang*/ ru ru s+phu ru dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyis bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi dwangs ma bdud rtsi dmar po mtshal da chu'i khu ba lta bu ro brgya dang ldan par gyur te/ sgrol ma'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas zag pa med pa'i bde bas dgyes par bsams la/

rtsa ba'i sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab bo// lugs phyi ma ltar na gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas dkar cha bzhi nas 'byung ba'i/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ zhes pa nas sañca re swā hā'i bar dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo wa shaṃ ma nā ya swā hā/ i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sbrel bas 'bul bar bshad/ gang ltar yang dril sgrub yin tshe bdag mdun thun mong du mchod bstod bya zhing*/ gtor ma mdun bskyed kho na la 'bul/ so sor yin tshe dgong thun dang*/ srod thun la de nyid sor bzhag dang*/ snga thun gnyis la bdag bskyed kyi mchod bstod tshar rjes/ gtor mgron spyi ltar yan lag bzhis bskyed pa sogs bya dgos te sgrub thabs rnying pa 'ga' res shes so// de nas mdun bskyed la nongs pa bzod gsol dang brtan bzhugs byas la/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ dge ba bsngo/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis legs par bsgrubs pas zhag bcu bzhi tsam nas nyams sam rmi lam du bud med gzhon nu ma mang pos rgyan dang zas gos stob cing 'du ba dang*/ khrom 'du zhing khri la 'dug pa/ mang pos bkur ba/ bsgrub bya nyid gus pa'i tshul gyis 'du ba sogs 'byung ste/ zhag nyer gcig gis nges par 'grub gsungs/ sgo nga ster ba dang*/ rta bong dang*/ skyes pa bud med mtshan ma ston pa byung na phyi thal yin pas sgrub pa'i bungs bskyed/ dmigs pa gzer drag tu btang bas 'grub par gdon mi za gsungs so// rig pa 'thibs pa dang grib rmis byung na grib sel bya/ mdze pho mo rmis na dam tshig gso/ sprang po rmis na mchod gtor la rtsal 'don/ don du na gnad dam pa ni 'di yin te/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin la/ sems nyid kyang stong pa nyid du shes pas rang nyid sgrol ma'i sku snang stong zung 'jug tu shar bas/

bsgrub bya snying rje'i bsam pas 'od dmar po 'khrigs pa sogs kyis dbang du bsdu ba'i dmigs pa bya/ tshur bsdus nas bsgrub bya'i sems dang rang gi sems dbyer med du ro mnyam zhing rig stong mtha' bral du bzhag pas dbang sdud pa rnams kyi gegs thu shos shes pa khro tshig rgod pa gzhan dbang du 'chor ba sogs ye mi 'byung zhing*/ rang so tshugs pa dang rig sngags kyi rten 'brel gyis bsgrubs bya rang nyams dang bral bas dbang du mi 'du mi srid de gces pa'i man ngag go /spyi don gsum la rjes su 'gro ba'i man ngag la las kyi bogs 'don sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ sgrub pa thon nas ji ltar bya ba dang*/ dam tshig gi rim pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni zur du gsal/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa thon nas 'khor lo dar dmar pos dril/ zangs sam bse'i ga'ur zla gam bris par sbrang rtsi dang mar dang me tog dmar po dang bcas te bcug la rang gi mgul lam mchan khung g.yon du bcang*/ ril bu de bsgrub bya'i khong du btang ba'am/ lus la reg pas 'khor los sgyur ba'ang gor ma chag par dbang du 'gyur na gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos gsungs/ gal te bsgrub bya de dga' bzhin du mi 'ong ba dang*/ rang las bsgrub bya gzi brjid che bar rmi na/ de'i srung mas bskyabs pa yin pas/ kha sbyor dbye ba cung zad bya ste/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas bsgrub bya'i bshang lam nas zhugs/ de skyob pa'i lha ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa thams cad khang nang na mi bsdad pa bzhin bsgrub bya'i lus kyi nang du gnas pa la phog de'i srung 'khor yon tan bsod nams gzi brjid thams cad srung ma rnams kyis bsdus/ skyob pa'i lha thams cad 'od dmar po'i rnam par 'dril ba tshur byung*/ rang gi srung 'khor dang thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par dmigs la/ rtsa ba'i sngags la che ge mo'i srung ba'i go cha ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes btags pa brgya rtsa tsam bzla/

de nas liṅga de gu gul dang sha chen gyi du bas bdug cing che ge mo skyob pa'i lha dang phyes shig phaṭa/ ces bzla/ kho rang gi lha rten gyi dum bus liṅga la gdab bo// des ni bsgrub bya lha dang bye nas 'phral du dbang du 'gyur ro// sngon gyi las shugs kyis cis kyang ma grub na/ zangs gzhong du seng ldeng gi shing zla gam du brtsigs te me sbar ba la 'khor lo bsro zhing 'khor lo de sgrol ma dngos su gsal ba la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas khyod kyis dbang gi dngos grub bsgrub par khas 'ches pa las da mi bsgrub pa ci zhes khrel bdas kyi tshul du bskul bas/ sgrol mas nus mthu ci yod kyis rang dbang med par bsgrub bya dbang du bsdu bar bsams la las sngags ldog ste bzlas pas 'phral du 'grub par gdon mi za ste/ 'di ni shin tu rdugs na bya ba las gzhan du ni ma yin no// rje btsun ma 'di ni shin tu byin rlabs che ste 'di lan cig grub nas/ phyi nas gang la dmigs pa gtad pa tsam gyis grub par nges gsungs/ gsum pa dam tshig ni/ 'di sgrub pa gzhan gyis tshor rig med pa dang*/ shin tu gsang ba gal che zhing*/ zhud kyis 'khyer bas mchod rten 'khor lo phreng ba sogs gzhan la mi mngon pa dang*/ gdams pa gzhan du 'chal na rang gi dngos grub tshe rabs su nyams par bshad pas ma 'chal ba shin tu gal che gsungs so// myur mgyogs 'bras bzang 'dod pa 'jo ba yi// man ngag gser gyi snye ma'i phreng mdzes gang*// sngags rigs 'chang ba gzhon nu'i brang gi ngos// mdzes par spud pa'i dpal du ngas sbyin no// bsod nams 'dab ma stong gi snying po las// byung ba'i ye shes sbrang rtsi'i ro mngar pos// rab myos sngags kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa rnams// sa gsum chos kyi 'khor los sgyur thob shog /ces rje btsun ma sgrol ma dmar mo'i bsnyen sgrub las kyi man ngag bung ba myos pa'i 'gram chang zhes bya ba 'di ni rgya gzhung gnyis dang*/

yi ge rnying pa rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba dge sbyong wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhas mdo khams shar gyi phyogs rnam rgyal rtse'i mgon khang du bris pa'i dge bas bstan pa rin po che bkur sti dang bcas te yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i dbang gi sbyin sreg gi yig chung rak+ta muk+ti ka'i brang rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka tā rā yai/ phrin las 'od dmar glog ltar myur ba yis// brtan g.yo bsgul mdzad dbang gi sgrol ma dang*// dbyer med bla ma mchog la gus btud nas// las kyi bogs 'don sreg blugs cho ga spel// de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ rnam par dul ba'i gnas su stegs bu dmar por thab khung zla gam dmar po ngos shar bstan/ rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed/ mu ran dang kha khyer la sor bzhi bzhi yod pa/ kha khyer la lcags kyus mtshan pa/ nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar lcags kyu can bri brtsig brko ba gang rung bya/ der bud shing ni/ seng ldeng ngam/ kham bu'am/ shug pa'am/ mdzo mo shing sogs ro skyur zhing mdog dmar po can thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par brtsig thab kyi g.yas su kha dog dmar po'am/ 'bras bu can gyi shing tshon dmar pos bsgyur ba'i yam shing sor lnga pa grangs ji tsam dgos pa dri bzang po dang mngar gsum gyis sbags pa dang*/ tsha ba'i til mar ram mar khu la 'bri mog bsres pa dang*/ tsher ma lcags kyu can gyi shing dang*/ glang sna dang lug ru dmar po sogs me tog dmar po lcags kyu can rnyed tshad dang*/ 'bras chan zho dang mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i zas mchog dang*/ dar zab dmar po'i na bza' dang*/ bsgrub bya'i liṅga sngags can bris pa gang mang dgug gzhug byas pa rnams bsham/ yang g.yon du lhag pa'i lha dang me lha'i gtor ma gnyis dang*/

zangs snod du dri dang me tog dmar po blugs pa'i mchod yon dang*/ me tog dmar po dri zhim po dang*/ a ga ru'i spos dang*/ 'bri mog bsres pa'i mar me dang*/ tsan+dan dmar po dang gur gum sbyar ba'i dri chab dang*/ mngar gsum sbrus pa'i lha bshos dmar po ste mchod pa tshar gnyis bsham/ bris thab yin na mdun du me sgrib gangs ri'i dbyibs can zhig bzhag de'i nang du rdo dril/ bsang chu/ ku sha dgang blugs dang*/ rlung g.yab bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni srod chen po'i dus su/ bdag nyid khrus byas/ dri bzang dmar po dang sin+dhū ras lus la byug chas gos rgyan thams cad dmar por bya/ stan dmar po la kha nub tu bstan nas rdo rje'am sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 'dug la/ chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pas/ lha'i rnal 'byor shin tu brtan par bsgom/ smra ba bcad/ rdo dril bzung*/ bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces cung zad bzla/ sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i rtse mos bsang chu blangs te/ g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas skor du thab dang*/ bsreg rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dgang blugs thams cad bsang*/ rgyal po'am/ smad 'tshong ma'i nang nas byung ba'i me snod du bzhag pas dpal 'bar sbar nas bsangs la/ bud shing dang lhan du me tshang du bcug oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ ku shas thab g.yogs par gsungs kyang*/ 'byor dka' bas spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs nas tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram pa ni gegs zhi ba dang gtsang sbra'i dod po'o// de nas me bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las ye shes kyi thab khung zla gam dmar po mchu kha khyer dang bcas pa'i nang du/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du ram̐ las me lha dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa ag tshom can du gyur/

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas bkug la/ thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng du ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs pa la/ a mṛ te sogs brjod cing bsang chus phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod pa sna lnga rol mo dang bcas pas dbul/ pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis g.yas pas blugs gzar dang*/ g.yon pas dgang gzar bzung*/ lag pa gnyis pus mo'i nang las phyir mi 'da' bar byas la dgang blugs kyi kha la ram̐ dang me lha'i ljags la ram̐ bkod de/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes dang*/ dgang blugs g.yas su bskor bas me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul la/ me'i ltas brtag de nas/ yam shing dang*/ sreg blugs dang*/ me tog dmar po dang*/ zas mchog rnams bdun bdun dbul/ de'i tshe sngags ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ che ge mo'am dmigs bsal med na khams gsum snod bcud thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pa 'ba' zhig gis dbul/ yam shing dang me tog ni g.yas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mtheb srin gyis dbul/ gzhan rnams ni blugs gzar gyis dbul ba ni sreg blugs yin la/ dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba'i steng du blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba sbrags nas 'bul ba ni dgang blugs so// yam shing ni me'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ me tog ni phyag tu/ gzhan rnams ni zhal du 'bul lo// de nas bsang chus bsangs pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar po'i steng du hrīḥdamar po las ut+pa la dmar po lte bar hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma sogs kyis sgrol ma sgrub thabs ltar bskyed bstim dbang bskur/

mchod bstod byas la/ sgrol ma'i zhal la hrīḥdang dgang blugs kyi kha la hrīḥbakod la las sngags kyis mar dgang blugs bdun dbul/ de nas yam shing dang*/ sreg blugs dang*/ me tog dmar po dang*/ zas mchog rnams rim par las sngags 'ba' zhig gis dbul/ yam shing dang*/ sreg blugs dang*/ me tog 'bul thengs re dang sngags re sbyar ba la sbyin sreg ces bya ba yin pas grangs bzung ste brgya stong gi bar 'bul lo// de nas liṅga rnams dbul zhing sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i las sbyor gyi dmigs pa de dag gsal bar nan tan gyis bsgom/ de nas las sngags kyis na bza' dbul/ gtor ma'ang byin gyis brlabs nas/ las sngags sam gtor sngags brjod cing dgang blugs kyis dbul/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ lhag chad bskang*/ bzod gsol dang gshegs gsol bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi chos ni/ de nas me 'bar ba me lhar gyur pa la sngar gyi sngags kyis na bza' dang*/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas sngar gyi sngags la ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa spel tshig dang bcas pas dbul/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams sngar ltar ma lus par 'bul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ ag+na ye gats+tshas gshegs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ long skabs yod na me ma shi'i bar du mi dkrugs/ mi bdal/ mi 'gom/ long med na 'bri mog gis bsgyur ba'i 'o ma dmar pos me gzhil/ gang ltar yang thal ba bsgrub byas 'thung ba'i chu bo la dor bas dbang du 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// bsnyen sgrub las kyi pho nya rab myur yang*// bogs 'byin sbyor ba'i lag cha dang bral na// dbang bya khug pa'i phrin las 'gyang srid pas// cho ga 'di ni las kyi mchil rnon yin// zhes rje btsun sgrol ma dmar mo'i dbang gi sbyin sreg gi yig chung rak+ta muk+ti ka'i brang rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni yig rnying mdzad byang mi gsal ba zhig la brten nas rang gzhung gi yan lag tu/

wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhas bla chen 'phags pa yab sras kyi phrin las khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rdzas 'dzin rnam rgyal mgon khang du sbyar ba'i dge bas sgrub pa po rnams pad+ma'i 'khor los sgyur ba rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar gyur cig/ ༈ /dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i brgyud 'debs srid zhi'i dge legs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// thub pa'i dbang po 'phags ma sgrol mdzad ma// ngag dbang grags pa rdo rje gdan pa dang*// ba ri lo tsā rje btsun brtse ba che// bsod nams rtse mo rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grags pa rgyal mtshan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// shākya 'od zer rgyal tsha lung mang po// mkhas mchog yon tan khri dang seṅge dpal// seṅge rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// klu pa bsod dar dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od// grags pa 'byung gnas bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// rin chen chos rgyal sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs// dkon mchog lhun grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas seṅge nam mkha' dpal bzang po// mchog legs rdo rje mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// ngag dbang lhun grub rmor chen dpal chos zhabs// kun dga' rnam rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' blo gros dang*// bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan tshul khrims rab rgyas dpal// kun dga' bzang po tshul khrims dpal bzang dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams dang sgrol mdzad ma// myur ma dpa' mo'i dbang gi phrin las 'od// rab dmar glog ltar myur ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// snod bcud rang dbang med par bskyod du gsol// sngags spyod gser gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i phreng*// rim brgyud gdams pa lha yi btung ba yis// rnam par myos pa'i sngags rig 'dzin pa bdag /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i khrir 'dzegs shog /bkra shis kun 'byung bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// bkra shis dbang phyug mchog gsum bden pa dang*// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'phags ma'i byin rlabs kyis// bkra shis rgya mtshos 'gro kun 'byor gyur cig
